editor.aParte: This part saves with its own button.

secoes.ajuda: Choose what shows on your profile, above the tabs, and in which order. Nothing shows unless you choose it.
secoes.noPerfil: On the profile, in this order
secoes.nenhuma: No section chosen: the profile shows only the header and the tabs.

ajudas.sobre: A longer text than the bio.
ajudas.comunidades: Only the ones you choose, one by one.
ajudas.voluntariado: The Institute fronts you worked in, confirmed by the coordination.
ajudas.destaques: Highlights of stories, posts and actions.

sobre.ajuda: Plain text, up to {max} characters. Shows only with the About section on.

comunidades.ajuda: Only the ones you tick show, among the open communities you take part in. Leaving a community removes it from the profile at once.
comunidades.nenhuma: You are not in any open community yet.

trilhas.ajuda: Marked by the person, from the study on their own device.

links.ajuda: Up to {max}, in the order you want. https only; tracking parameters are removed. Nobody counts clicks.
links.invalido: Check the title (up to {max} characters) and the address (https).
links.conferidoRelMe: Verified: the site links back to this profile
links.comoConferir: To verify, put on your site a link to your profile with rel="me":
links.naoAchou: We did not find the link back on that page. Check it is there, with rel="me", and try again.
links.semServico: Verification is not available right now. Try later.

instagram.ajuda: Instagram does not allow rel="me". Ask mediation: you get a code to put in your bio there, and mediation checks it.

status.soRoda: Only your trust circle sees this status.

voluntariado.ajuda: The Institute work fronts you were part of, in years. The coordination confirms each line; only confirmed lines show, and only with the section on.
voluntariado.mudarVolta: Changing a confirmed line sends it back to the coordination.

pacotes.ajuda: The team puts together packs of profiles for newcomers to follow. You only join a pack if you accept its invitation, and you leave whenever you want.
pacotes.foraDeTodos: You are not in any pack.
pacotes.fechado: Packs are only for open profiles: with a locked or invisible profile you cannot join.
pacotes.noPasso: You only join a pack when you accept its invitation, in Edit profile › Packs.

pacote.vazio: Nobody has joined this pack yet.
pacote.soQuemAceitou: Only people who accepted to join this pack are here.
pacote.qrAjuda: Made here on the device, with no outside service. Show it on screen or print it.
pacote.qrFalhou: Could not make the QR code on this device.
pacote.naoAchado: This pack does not exist or was closed.
pacote.entrar: Sign in to Alumia to see who is in the pack.

cuidar.ajuda: Inviting does not put anyone in the pack: the person gets the invitation and joins only if they accept.
cuidar.convidado: Invitation sent. The person joins only if they accept.

voluntariado.ajuda: Each line was written by the person. Confirm only what the coordination knows happened. Declining needs a reason.

links.ajuda: Open the profile there and check the code is in the bio. Only then mark it.

erros.invalido:sobre: The About text is too long.
erros.invalido:comunidades: You can only show open communities you take part in.
erros.invalido:links: Check the links: short title and https address without tracking.
erros.invalido:frente: Choose a front from the list.
erros.invalido:pessoa: This profile cannot be in a pack (it must be open).
erros.perfil_fechado: Packs are only for open profiles.
erros.sem_permissao: You do not have permission for this.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a little.
erros.generico: That did not work. Try again.
